items.title: Contract Drama Over In TB: Baker Mayfield, Buccaneers Reportedly Agree To Extension
items.summary: The Tampa Bay Buccaneers and Baker Mayfield have agreed to a three-year, $165 million extension, putting an end to one of the summer’s most dramatic contract standoffs.
